/-
  TRAINING SPLIT variant, generated by harness/tools/split.py from the full file: the lines that read the
  atoms the split omits are removed. Do not edit; regenerate.
-/
/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Primitives
  What the formula language cannot express, each a geometric computation with no legal word in it:
  a heading change integrated over a window, the closest approach of two bodies under constant
  velocities, the structured matching of a sign's legend. One definition per `prim.*` id of the
  ontology, named `prim_name`, computed over the whole trace from atoms only, parameters as
  arguments with no default.

  A concept (a pipeline node) is written over atoms and primitives in the formula language and
  expanded before evaluation; nothing else computes a manoeuvre here. `Ctx` is the trace indexed
  for evaluation, shared with Semantics.lean.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.RegionTable
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Params
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Accumulate

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Primitives
open Temporal

/-- Whether two boundaries are the same list of vertices, each coordinate compared by its
    numerator and denominator. -/
def sameBoundary : List Vec → List Vec → Bool
  | [], [] => true
  | a :: as, b :: bs =>
    a.1.num == b.1.num && a.1.den == b.1.den && a.2.num == b.2.num && a.2.den == b.2.den && sameBoundary as bs
  | _, _ => false

theorem sameBoundary_eq : ∀ {a b : List Vec}, sameBoundary a b = true → a = b
  | [], [], _ => rfl
  | a :: as, b :: bs, h => by
    simp only [sameBoundary, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at h
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩, h5⟩ := h
    rcases a with ⟨⟨an1, ad1, _⟩, ⟨an2, ad2, _⟩⟩
    rcases b with ⟨⟨bn1, bd1, _⟩, ⟨bn2, bd2, _⟩⟩
    simp only at h1 h2 h3 h4
    subst h1 h2 h3 h4
    rw [sameBoundary_eq h5]
  | [], _ :: _, h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h
  | _ :: _, [], h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h

/-- A region's boundary with its simple-polygon flag, computed the first time it is read; the flag
    is the direct check of that boundary by construction. -/
structure SimpleEntry where
  id : RegionId
  boundary : List Vec
  flag : Thunk Bool
  ok : flag.get = Geom.simplePolygon boundary

/-- One entry per region and distinct boundary in the trace: a map's boundaries do not change from
    scene to scene, so each is checked once however many scenes and calls read it. -/
def simpleTable (scenes : Array Scene) : List SimpleEntry :=
  scenes.foldl (fun acc s => s.structures.foldl (fun acc st =>
      match st.boundary with
      | none => acc
      | some b =>
        if acc.any (fun e => e.id == st.id && sameBoundary e.boundary b) then acc
        else ⟨st.id, b, Thunk.mk (fun _ => Geom.simplePolygon b), rfl⟩ :: acc) acc) []

/-- The trace indexed for evaluation, with the run's reading. `aggregateOverrides` fixes the
    membership of a track in an aggregate to a value, for the sensitivity of a verdict to that
    membership; it is empty in every evaluation that judges a trace. -/
structure Ctx where
  scenes : Array Scene
  times : Array Q
  ρ : Reading
  aggregateOverrides : List (TrackId × String × Bool) := []
  /-- The simple-polygon flags of the trace's boundaries (`simpleIn`). -/
  simple : List SimpleEntry := simpleTable scenes
  /-- What a region quantifier reads of these scenes, built once and shared by every evaluation of
      this context (`RegionTable`). -/
  regions : RegionTable.Tables scenes := RegionTable.Tables.build scenes

/-- Whether a region's boundary is a simple polygon, read from the trace's table when the region and
    its boundary are there, checked directly otherwise. -/
def simpleIn (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  match c.simple.find? (fun e => e.id == r && sameBoundary e.boundary poly) with
  | some e => e.flag.get
  | none => Geom.simplePolygon poly

/-- The table never changes the answer: a hit is the direct check of the same boundary, a miss (a
    region or boundary not in the table, a boundary changed since) is the direct check. -/
theorem simpleIn_eq (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : simpleIn c r poly = Geom.simplePolygon poly := by
  unfold simpleIn
  split
  · rename_i e h
    have hp := List.find?_some h
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hp
    rw [e.ok, sameBoundary_eq hp.2]
  · rfl

def Ctx.mk' (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) : Ctx :=
  { scenes := τ.toArray, times := (τ.map fun s => Time.ofTimestamp s.t).toArray, ρ := ρ }
def Ctx.n (c : Ctx) : Nat := c.scenes.size

/-- An argument as the dispatcher receives it: a resolved entity id (tracks, regions and devices
    are all `Nat`), an enumeration spelling, or a natural. -/
inductive DArg
  | v (id : Nat)
  | s (lit : String)
  | n (nat : Nat)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lifting scene functions over the trace; positions for windows
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def each (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → R) : Array R := c.scenes.map f
def eachQ (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → QR) : Array QR := c.scenes.map f
def timePos (c : Ctx) : Array (Option Q) := c.times.map some
def pathPos (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) : Array (Option Q) := c.scenes.map (kin_path_length · x)
def positions (c : Ctx) (m : Measure) (x : TrackId) : Array (Option Q) :=
  match m with | .time => timePos c | .path => pathPos c x
def missingPos (m : Measure) : UnknownReason :=
  match m with | .time => .outOfRange | .path => .absentAtom "kin_path_length"

def bAtom (o : Option Bool) (name : String) : R := R.ofOption o (.absentAtom name)
def qAtom (o : Option Q) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some q => .ok q | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Scene-level helpers over atoms
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Heading change (degrees, left positive) integrated over the back window of length w:
    prefix sums of yaw rate × interval, one window query per instant. -/
def yawChange (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : Array (Except UnknownReason Q) :=
  let n := c.n
  -- sums[i] = Σ_{k ≤ i} ω_k (t_k − t_{k−1}); a missing yaw rate contributes nothing and is tracked
  let sums := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Q) i =>
    let prev := if i = 0 then Q.zero else acc[i - 1]!
    let dt := if i = 0 then Q.zero else Q.sub c.times[i]! c.times[i - 1]!
    acc.push (match kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x with
      | some ω => Q.add prev (Q.mul ω dt)
      | none => prev)) #[]
  -- lastMissing[i] = latest index ≤ i with a missing yaw rate (n when none)
  let lastMissing := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.push (if (kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x).isNone then i else (if i = 0 then n else acc[i - 1]!))) #[]
  let wins := Time.backWindows (timePos c) w
  (Array.range n).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => .error .outOfRange
    | some win =>
      if !win.covered then .error (.windowTruncated "prim_heading_change")
      else if !win.adequate then .error (.samplingGap "prim_heading_change")
      else
        let lm := lastMissing[i]!
        if lm ≠ n && lm > win.j0 then .error (.absentAtom "kin_yaw_rate")
        else .ok (Q.sub sums[i]! sums[win.j0]!)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The primitives
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- minute m of the day lies in the window [start, end), wrapping past midnight when end ≤ start. -/
def inWindow (w : TimeWindow) (m : Nat) : Bool :=
  if w.startMinute < w.endMinute then w.startMinute ≤ m && m < w.endMinute
  else m ≥ w.startMinute || m < w.endMinute

private def hasClassOpt (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (k : RoadUserClass) : Option Bool :=
  (s.user x).bind fun u => if u.unobservedClasses.contains k then none else u.classes.map (·.contains k)

private def vecAtom (o : Option Vec) (name : String) : Except UnknownReason Vec :=
  match o with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.absentAtom name)

/-- Under constant velocities, the time of closest approach of the two centres and the centre
    distance then; `none` when the paths do not approach within `[0, horizon]`. -/
private def closestApproach (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Except UnknownReason (Option (Q × Q)) := do
  let pa ← vecAtom (kin_position s a) "kin_position"
  let pb ← vecAtom (kin_position s b) "kin_position"
  let va ← vecAtom (kin_velocity s a) "kin_velocity"
  let vb ← vecAtom (kin_velocity s b) "kin_velocity"
  let r := Geom.vsub pb pa
  let v := Geom.vsub vb va
  let vv := Geom.dot v v
  if Q.isZero vv then pure none
  else
    let tstar := Q.neg (Q.div (Geom.dot r v) vv)
    if Q.lt tstar Q.zero || Q.gt tstar horizon then pure none
    else pure (some (tstar, Geom.norm (Geom.vadd r (Q.mul tstar v.1, Q.mul tstar v.2))))

/-- Signed heading change (degrees, left positive) over the back window w, integrated from the yaw
    rate; unknown where the window is truncated, sparsely sampled or a yaw rate is missing. -/
def prim_heading_change (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : Array QR :=
  (yawChange c x w).map fun e => match e with
    | .error r => .error (match r with
        | .windowTruncated _ => .windowTruncated "prim_heading_change"
        | .samplingGap _ => .samplingGap "prim_heading_change"
        | other => other)
    | .ok Δ => .ok Δ

/-- The centres approach each other within the horizon. -/
def prim_closest_approach_within (c : Ctx) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Array R :=
  each c fun s => match closestApproach s a b horizon with
    | .error w => R.u w
    | .ok o => R.ofBool o.isSome

/-- The time of closest approach; undefined when the centres do not approach within the horizon. -/
def prim_closest_approach_time (c : Ctx) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Array QR :=
  eachQ c fun s => do
    match ← closestApproach s a b horizon with
    | some (t, _) => pure t
    | none => throw (.undefined "prim_closest_approach_time")

/-- The centre distance at closest approach; undefined when the centres do not approach within the horizon. -/
def prim_closest_approach_distance (c : Ctx) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Array QR :=
  eachQ c fun s => do
    match ← closestApproach s a b horizon with
    | some (_, dist) => pure dist
    | none => throw (.undefined "prim_closest_approach_distance")

/-- The legend conditions of device d hold now for road user x: a time window on a listed day (or a
    calendar class the scene declares), any occupancy or class condition, children present. -/
def prim_conditions_hold (c : Ctx) (d : DeviceId) (x : TrackId) : Array R :=
  each c fun s =>
    let conds := match dev_zone_sign_conditions s d with
      | some cd => some cd
      | none => dev_regulatory_sign_conditions s d
    R.bindOpt conds (.absentAtom "dev_zone_sign_conditions") fun cd =>
      let timeOk : R :=
        if cd.windows.isEmpty then R.t
        else R.bindOpt (env_civil_time s) (.absentAtom "env_civil_time") fun ct =>
          R.any (cd.windows.map fun w =>
            let dayOk : R := match w.calendarClass with
              | some cls => R.ofOption (s.assumption cls) (.assumptionMissing cls)
              | none => R.ofBool (w.weekdays.isEmpty || w.weekdays.contains ct.weekday)
            R.and dayOk (R.ofBool (inWindow w ct.minuteOfDay)))
      let occOk : R := match cd.minOccupancy with
        | none => R.t
        | some n => bAtom ((ru_occupant_count s x).map (· ≥ n)) "ru_occupant_count"
      let clsOk : R := match cd.vehicleClass with
        | none => R.t
        | some k => bAtom (hasClassOpt s x k) "ru_class"
      let childOk : R :=
        if cd.whenChildrenPresent then R.any (s.tracks.map fun y => bAtom (ru_child s y) "ru_child") else R.t
      R.and (R.and timeOk occOk) (R.and clsOk childOk)

/-- The signed lateral offset of region r from road user x (m, left positive): the component,
    perpendicular to x's heading, of the vector from x's reference point to the nearest point of
    r's boundary; zero where the reference point lies inside r. Where several boundary points are
    equally nearest, their common component; undefined where those components differ. -/
def prim_region_lateral_offset (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Array QR :=
  eachQ c fun s => do
    let some p := kin_position s x | throw (.absentAtom "kin_position")
    let some h := kin_heading s x | throw (.absentAtom "kin_heading")
    let some poly := st_region_geometry_boundary s r | throw (.absentAtom "st_region_geometry")
    if Geom.inPolygon p poly then pure Q.zero
    else
      let lats ← (Geom.nearestPoints p poly).mapM fun q =>
        match Geom.inFrame h (Geom.vsub q p) with
        | some (_, lat) => pure lat
        | none => throw (.absentAtom "kin_heading")
      match lats with
      | [] => throw (.absentAtom "st_region_geometry")
      | l :: ls => if ls.all (Q.eq · l) then pure l else throw (.undefined "prim_region_lateral_offset")

/-- The signed distance (m) from road user x's reference point to region r, along carrier l's
    designated direction, on the line through the reference point parallel to that direction. r is
    a closed set: a vertex the line only touches and an edge it runs along are points of r it meets.
    Zero where the reference point lies in r or on its boundary; where every point of r on the line
    lies ahead, the distance to the nearest of them; where every one lies behind, minus the distance
    to the nearest. Where the line does not meet r, the value comes from r's projection on the
    direction, the interval [lo, hi] of the signed distances of r's points along it: lo where lo > 0,
    hi where hi < 0. That value is a projection gap, not a distance along the line, so the value may
    jump where the line starts or stops meeting r; its sign gives the side in both cases. Undefined
    where the line meets r both ahead and behind, where it misses r and [lo, hi] spans or touches
    zero, and where
    r's boundary is not a simple polygon (an empty list, fewer than three vertices, zero area, or a
    boundary that crosses or touches itself); unknown where the position, the direction (a zero
    vector included) or the boundary is absent. Independent of the boundary's start vertex and
    orientation. The direction is normalised as `st_lane_direction` is read (`Geom.unit`, with Core's
    micrometre-rounded square root), and the distance is counted in lengths of that normalised
    vector, which lie between 1 and 1 + 2·10⁻⁶ m. The value is geometry only: it does not establish
    that x is on l, that r marks l's entrance, that x's whole body has crossed r, or that a crossing
    happened between observations, and a distance to r is read from `st_region_geometry_distance`. -/
def prim_region_offset_along (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (r l : RegionId) : Array QR :=
  eachQ c fun s => do
    let some p := kin_position s x | throw (.absentAtom "kin_position")
    let some u := (st_lane_direction s l).bind Geom.unit | throw (.absentAtom "st_lane_direction")
    let some poly := st_region_geometry_boundary s r | throw (.absentAtom "st_region_geometry")
    if !simpleIn c r poly then throw (.undefined "prim_region_offset_along")
    let ts := Geom.lineCrossings p u poly
    if Geom.inPolygon p poly || Geom.onBoundary p poly then pure Q.zero
    else match ts with
      | [] =>
        match poly.map fun q => Q.div (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub q p) u) (Geom.dot u u) with
        | [] => throw (.undefined "prim_region_offset_along")
        | t :: rest =>
          if (t :: rest).all (Q.lt Q.zero ·) then pure (rest.foldl Q.min t)
          else if (t :: rest).all (Q.lt · Q.zero) then pure (rest.foldl Q.max t)
          else throw (.undefined "prim_region_offset_along")
      | t :: rest =>
        if ts.all (Q.lt Q.zero ·) then pure (rest.foldl Q.min t)
        else if ts.all (Q.lt · Q.zero) then pure (rest.foldl Q.max t)
        else throw (.undefined "prim_region_offset_along")

/-- Path length over which `holds` has held continuously up to each instant (`Term.distanceWhile`). -/
def distanceWhile (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (holds : Array R) : Array QR :=
  Temporal.distanceWhileAll (pathPos c x) holds

/-- Signed heading change (degrees, left positive) of road user x since ψ last became true
    (`Term.headingSince`), integrated from the yaw rate as `prim_heading_change` integrates it, with
    `maxStep` bounding every interval from the one ending at the start. -/
def headingSince (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (maxStep : Q) (ψ : Array R) : Array QR :=
  Accumulate.sinceRiseIntegralAll c.times (c.scenes.map (kin_yaw_rate · x)) maxStep "heading_since"
    (.absentAtom "kin_yaw_rate") ψ

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Tables and dispatch by name
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Every `prim_*` definition of this file. The doctor holds this against `primitiveIds`. -/
def primitiveNames : List String :=
  ["prim_heading_change", "prim_closest_approach_within", "prim_closest_approach_time",
   "prim_closest_approach_distance", "prim_conditions_hold", "prim_region_lateral_offset",
   "prim_region_offset_along"]

/-- The atoms each primitive reads (Lean names of Atoms.lean); Manifest.lean turns a primitive
    into the atoms a source must observe. -/
def reads (n : String) : List String :=
  match n with
  | "prim_heading_change" => ["kin_yaw_rate"]
  | "prim_closest_approach_within" | "prim_closest_approach_time" | "prim_closest_approach_distance" => ["kin_position", "kin_velocity"]
  | "prim_conditions_hold" => ["dev_zone_sign", "dev_regulatory_sign", "env_civil_time", "ru_occupant_count", "ru_child"]
  | "prim_region_lateral_offset" => ["kin_position", "kin_heading", "st_region_geometry"]
  | "prim_region_offset_along" => ["kin_position", "st_lane_direction", "st_region_geometry"]
  | _ => []

/-- The sort each entity argument of a primitive must have (`none` marks a literal or natural
    position). The static check holds variables to these. -/
def argSorts (name : String) : Option (List (Option EntityKind)) :=
  let t := some EntityKind.track
  match name with
  | "prim_heading_change" => some [t]
  | "prim_closest_approach_within" | "prim_closest_approach_time" | "prim_closest_approach_distance" => some [t, t]
  | "prim_conditions_hold" => some [some EntityKind.device, t]
  | "prim_region_lateral_offset" => some [t, some EntityKind.region]
  | "prim_region_offset_along" => some [t, some EntityKind.region, some EntityKind.region]
  | _ => none

private def tid (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason TrackId :=
  match a with | .v t => .ok t | .n n => .ok n | _ => .error (.malformed "entity")

/-- A name no primitive carries: a concept call that no expansion replaced, or a misspelling. -/
private def unknownName (n : String) : UnknownReason :=
  if primitiveNames.contains n then .malformed s!"arity {n}" else .malformed s!"concept {n}"

/-- Boolean primitives by name. Unlisted names and wrong arities are `malformed`. -/
def evalB (name : String) (c : Ctx) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) : Except UnknownReason (Array R) :=
  match name, args, ps with
  | "prim_closest_approach_within", [a, b], [h] => do pure (prim_closest_approach_within c (← tid a) (← tid b) h)
  | "prim_conditions_hold", [d, x], [] => do pure (prim_conditions_hold c (← tid d) (← tid x))
  | n, _, _ => .error (unknownName n)

/-- Quantity-valued primitives by name. -/
def evalQ (name : String) (c : Ctx) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) : Except UnknownReason (Array QR) :=
  match name, args, ps with
  | "prim_heading_change", [x], [w] => do pure (prim_heading_change c (← tid x) w)
  | "prim_closest_approach_time", [a, b], [h] => do pure (prim_closest_approach_time c (← tid a) (← tid b) h)
  | "prim_closest_approach_distance", [a, b], [h] => do pure (prim_closest_approach_distance c (← tid a) (← tid b) h)
  | "prim_region_lateral_offset", [x, r], [] => do pure (prim_region_lateral_offset c (← tid x) (← tid r))
  | "prim_region_offset_along", [x, r, l], [] => do pure (prim_region_offset_along c (← tid x) (← tid r) (← tid l))
  | n, _, _ => .error (unknownName n)


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lengths: a primitive returns one value per observation.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
theorem size_each (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → R) : (each c f).size = c.n := by simp [each, Ctx.n]
theorem size_eachQ (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → QR) : (eachQ c f).size = c.n := by simp [eachQ, Ctx.n]
theorem size_prim_heading_change (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : (prim_heading_change c x w).size = c.n := by
  simp [prim_heading_change, yawChange]
theorem size_distanceWhile (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (holds : Array R) :
    (distanceWhile c x holds).size = holds.size := by
  simp [distanceWhile, Temporal.size_distanceWhileAll]
theorem size_headingSince (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (g : Q) (ψ : Array R) :
    (headingSince c x g ψ).size = ψ.size := by
  simp [headingSince, Accumulate.size_sinceRiseIntegralAll]

/-- A Boolean primitive that returns an array returns one value per observation. -/
theorem size_evalB (name : String) (c : Ctx) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) (a : Array R)
    (h : evalB name c args ps = .ok a) : a.size = c.n := by
  unfold evalB at h
  split at h <;> (try simp only [bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h) <;> (repeat' split at h) <;>
    first | (cases h; simp [prim_closest_approach_within, prim_conditions_hold, size_each]) | cases h

/-- A quantity primitive that returns an array returns one value per observation. -/
theorem size_evalQ (name : String) (c : Ctx) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) (a : Array QR)
    (h : evalQ name c args ps = .ok a) : a.size = c.n := by
  unfold evalQ at h
  split at h <;> (try simp only [bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h) <;> (repeat' split at h) <;>
    first
    | (cases h; simp [prim_heading_change, yawChange, prim_closest_approach_time, prim_closest_approach_distance,
                      prim_region_lateral_offset, prim_region_offset_along, size_eachQ, Ctx.n])
    | cases h

-- One integral, one interval convention, one unit
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ++ (st.ways.getD []).map (fun r => { place := at_ "ways", kind := .region, id := r })

  ++ (s.devices.flatMap fun d => d.governs.map fun r => { place := s!"device {d.id} governs", kind := .region, id := r })

3	  atoms the split omits are removed. Do not edit; regenerate.
4	-/
5	/-
6	  TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Manifest
7	  What a source can observe: a capability per atom id, complete over ATOMS.md (`subject` is an atom
8	  observed for the subject track alone, as an instrumented vehicle reports its own controls); a mask
9	  that blanks every field of an absent atom, and of a subject-only atom on every other road user,
10	  before evaluation; and `support`, the first and most honest number
11	  a source gets — which rules it can be judged against at all, computed from the rules' syntax
12	  before any frame is read.
13	
14	  The same rules run on a simulator, on an annotated dataset and on perception over video; the
15	  only thing that differs is what each can see, and that difference is a declared input here.
16	  For the perception stage the manifest is the interface the other way round: the list of atoms
17	  its programs must deliver, with the error class each is allowed.
18	-/
19	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule
20	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Semantics
21	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Ontology.Ids
22	
23	namespace TrafficSpec
24	
25	inductive Capability
26	  | exact
27	  | estimate (errorClass : String)
28	  | absent
29	  | subject
30	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
31	
32	structure Manifest where
33	  source : String
34	  entries : List (String × Capability)     -- atom id in ATOMS.md form ↦ capability
35	  /-- The longest tracker break the source's re-identification links may bridge (seconds). -/
36	  reidGap : Q := Q.zero
37	  deriving Repr, Inhabited
38	
39	namespace Manifest
40	/-- An atom the manifest does not list is absent: silence is not a capability. -/
41	def capability (m : Manifest) (id : String) : Capability :=
42	  ((m.entries.find? (·.1 == id)).map (·.2)).getD .absent
43	def observes (m : Manifest) (id : String) : Bool := m.capability id != .absent
44	/-- Complete: every atom id of ATOMS.md has an entry, and no entry names anything else. -/
45	def complete (m : Manifest) : Bool :=
46	  atomIds.all (fun id => (m.entries.find? (·.1 == id)).isSome) &&
47	  m.entries.all (fun e => atomIds.contains e.1)
48	def absentIds (m : Manifest) : List String := atomIds.filter fun id => !m.observes id
49	/-- The atoms observed for the subject track only. -/
50	def subjectIds (m : Manifest) : List String := atomIds.filter fun id => m.capability id == .subject
51	/-- A manifest that observes everything exactly (the simulator's, and the tests'). -/
52	def full (source : String) (gap : Q := Q.zero) : Manifest :=
53	  { source := source, entries := atomIds.map fun id => (id, .exact), reidGap := gap }
54	end Manifest
55	
56	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
57	-- From Lean names back to atom ids
58	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
59	/-- The atom id a Lean name reads: the longest id whose `defName` is a prefix of the name
60	    (`dev_traffic_signal_shows` ↦ `dev.traffic_signal`), with the relation aliases spelled out. -/
61	def atomIdOf (name : String) : Option String :=
62	  let n := match name with
63	    | "rel_ahead_in_lane" | "rel_behind_in_lane" => "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane"
64	    | other => other
65	  let cands := atomIds.filter fun id =>
66	    let d := Semantics.defName id
67	    n == d || n.startsWith (d ++ "_")
68	  cands.foldl (fun acc id => match acc with
69	    | none => some id
70	    | some a => if id.length > a.length then some id else some a) none
71	
72	/-- The atom ids a read of `id` depends on: itself, and for a read of a region kind or of a relation
73	    that reads kind membership, the kinds whose masks its verdict follows (a kind's ancestors; a
74	    lane relation's lane kind; an entrance's line kinds, stop line and crosswalk). No source
75	    declares an abstract kind: a read of one depends on the kinds refining it directly, and no read
76	    depends on an abstract ancestor. -/
77	def kindDependencies (id : String) : List String :=
78	  let kinds (ks : List StructureKind) := (ks.filter (!·.isAbstract)).map fun k => s!"st.{k}"
79	  let ofKind (k : StructureKind) :=
80	    if k.isAbstract then kinds (StructureKind.all.filter (·.parent? == some k))
81	    else kinds (k :: k.ancestors)
82	  match id with
83	  | "rel.ahead_behind_in_lane" => id :: ofKind .lane
84	  | "st.entrance_of" => id :: ofKind .stopLine ++ ofKind .crosswalk
85	  | _ =>
86	    if id.startsWith "st." then
87	      match StructureKind.ofString ((id.drop 3).toString) with
88	      | some k => ofKind k
89	      | none => [id]
90	    else [id]
91	
92	/-- The atom ids a formula list reads, through atoms and primitives (a concept call is expanded first). -/
93	def formulaAtomIds (fs : List Formula) : List String :=
94	  ((fs.flatMap Formula.atoms).flatMap fun n =>
95	    if n.startsWith "prim_" then (Primitives.reads n).filterMap atomIdOf
96	    else (atomIdOf n).toList).flatMap kindDependencies |>.eraseDups
97	
98	/-- The atom ids a rule reads, through its atoms, its primitives and, transitively, the
99	    rules it composes. -/
100	def Rule.atomIds (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) : List String :=
101	  let rec go (fuel : Nat) (seen : List String) (r : Rule) : List String :=
102	    match fuel with
103	    | 0 => formulaAtomIds r.formulas
104	    | fuel + 1 =>
105	      formulaAtomIds r.formulas ++ (r.composes.flatMap fun id =>
106	        if seen.contains id then [] else
107	        match rules.find? (·.id == id) with
108	        | some r' => go fuel (id :: seen) r'
109	        | none => [])
110	  (go rules.length [r.id] r).eraseDups
111	
112	inductive Support
113	  | supported
114	  | partially (absent : List String)      -- some atoms unobserved: verdicts may be unknown
115	  | unsupported (absent : List String)    -- the obligation reads nothing the source observes
116	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
117	
118	def Support.tag : Support → String
119	  | .supported => "supported"
120	  | .partially _ => "partial"
121	  | .unsupported _ => "unsupported"
122	def Support.absent : Support → List String
123	  | .supported => []
124	  | .partially a | .unsupported a => a
125	
126	/-- Support from syntax alone, closed over the rules a rule composes. Unsupported when every atom
127	    the obligation reads is absent (the rule could never decide), or a binder's class can never be
128	    established, or a composed rule is itself unsupported. -/
129	def support (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) (m : Manifest) : Support :=
130	  -- the clock is every source's: a window over time reads it, and no manifest declares it absent
131	  let absentOf (fs : List Formula) : List String × Nat :=
132	    let ids := (formulaAtomIds fs).filter (· != "kin.time")
133	    (ids.filter fun id => !m.observes id, ids.length)
134	  let (oblAbsent, oblTotal) := absentOf [r.obligation]
135	  let clsDead := r.binders.any fun b =>
136	    let (a, n) := absentOf [b.cls]
137	    n > 0 && a.length == n
138	  let composedDead := (r.composes.filterMap fun id => rules.find? (·.id == id)).any fun r' =>
139	    let (a, n) := absentOf [r'.obligation]
140	    n > 0 && a.length == n
141	  let allAbsent := (Rule.atomIds rules r).filter fun id => !m.observes id
142	  if allAbsent.isEmpty then .supported
143	  else if clsDead || composedDead || (oblTotal > 0 && oblAbsent.length == oblTotal) then .unsupported allAbsent
144	  else .partially allAbsent

146	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
147	-- Masking: a scene as the source would have produced it
148	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
149	namespace Mask
150	def user (id : String) (u : RoadUser) : RoadUser :=
151	  match id with
152	  | "ru.subject" => u
153	  | "ru.occupant_count" => { u with occupants := none }
154	  | "ru.rider_posture" => { u with posture := {} }
155	  | "kin.position" => { u with kin := { u.kin with position := none } }
156	  | "kin.heading" => { u with kin := { u.kin with heading := none } }
157	  | "kin.velocity" => { u with kin := { u.kin with velocity := none } }
158	  | "kin.speed" => { u with kin := { u.kin with speed := none } }
159	  | "kin.accel_longitudinal" => { u with kin := { u.kin with accelLongitudinal := none } }
160	  | "kin.yaw_rate" => { u with kin := { u.kin with yawRate := none } }
161	  | "kin.extent" => { u with kin := { u.kin with extent := none } }
162	  | "kin.steer_angle" => { u with kin := { u.kin with steerAngle := none } }
163	  | "kin.path_length" => { u with kin := { u.kin with pathLength := none } }
164	  | "kin.engine_running" => { u with kin := { u.kin with engineRunning := none } }
165	  | "kin.parking_brake" => { u with kin := { u.kin with parkingBrake := none } }
166	  | "kin.gear" => { u with kin := { u.kin with gear := none } }
167	  | "kin.throttle" => { u with kin := { u.kin with throttle := none } }
168	  | "kin.service_brake" => { u with kin := { u.kin with serviceBrake := none } }
169	  | "sig.turn_indicator" => { u with sig := { u.sig with turnIndicator := none } }
170	  | "sig.brake_lamp" => { u with sig := { u.sig with brakeLamp := none } }
171	  | "sig.hazard" => { u with sig := { u.sig with hazard := none } }
172	  | "sig.headlamp" => { u with sig := { u.sig with headlamp := none } }
173	  | "sig.position_lamp" => { u with sig := { u.sig with positionLamp := none } }
174	  | "sig.warning_lamp" => { u with sig := { u.sig with warningLamps := none } }
175	  | "sig.siren" => { u with sig := { u.sig with siren := none } }
176	  | "sig.horn" => { u with sig := { u.sig with horn := none } }
177	  | "sig.hand_signal" => { u with sig := { u.sig with handSignal := none } }
178	  | "ru.aggregate" => { u with classes := none }   -- the source classifies nothing: every member unknown
179	  | "sig.door_open" => { u with sig := { u.sig with doorsOpen := none } }
180	  | "sig.compression_brake" => { u with sig := { u.sig with compressionBrake := none } }
181	  | "st.sight_along_way" => { u with sightAlongWay := none }
182	  | _ =>
183	    -- a class atom: the source cannot tell this class, so no user is known to have or lack it,
184	    -- nor the attribute the class carries
185	    match RoadUserClass.ofString ((id.drop 3).toString) with
186	    | some k =>
187	      let u := { u with classes := u.classes.map (·.filter (· != k)), unobservedClasses := k :: u.unobservedClasses }
188	      match k with
189	      | .emergencyVehicle => { u with emergencyKind := none }
190	      | .officialVehicle => { u with officialKind := none }
191	      | .electricBicycle => { u with eBikeClass := none }
192	      | _ => u
193	    | none => u
194	
195	def structure' (id : String) (st : Structure) : Option Structure :=
196	  match id with
197	  | "st.lane_direction" => some { st with lane := st.lane.map fun l => { l with direction := none } }
198	  | "st.lane_adjacency" => some { st with lane := st.lane.map fun l =>
199	      { l with leftNeighbour := none, rightNeighbour := none, ordinalFromLeft := none, countInDirection := none } }
200	  | "st.lane_connectivity" => some { st with lane := st.lane.map fun l => { l with leadsTo := none } }
201	  | "st.lane_enters" => some { st with lane := st.lane.map fun l => { l with entersIntersection := none } }
202	  | "st.lane_marking" => some { st with lane := st.lane.map fun l => { l with markingLeft := none, markingRight := none } }
203	  | "st.lane_width" => some { st with lane := st.lane.map fun l => { l with width := none } }
204	  | "st.curvature" => some { st with curvature := none }
205	  | "st.grade" => some { st with grade := none }
206	  | "st.sight_distance" => some { st with sightDistance := none }
207	  | "st.on_way" => some { st with ways := none }
208	  | "st.entrance_of" => some { st with entranceOf := [], entranceObserved := false }
209	  | "st.region_geometry" => some { st with position := none, boundary := none }
210	  | _ =>
211	    -- a kind atom: the source cannot tell this kind; a kind that refines another is unknown only on
212	    -- the regions labelled with one of its ancestors (`Structure.isOfKind`); an abstract kind is
213	    -- never declared: what a source cannot tell of it is what it cannot tell of the kinds refining it
214	    match StructureKind.ofString ((id.drop 3).toString) with
215	    | some k => if k.isAbstract then some st else some { st with unobservedKinds := k :: st.unobservedKinds }
216	    | none => some st
217	
218	def device (id : String) (d : Device) : Option Device :=
219	  match id with
220	  | "dev.governs" => some { d with governs := [], governsObserved := false }
221	  | "dev.position" => some { d with position := none }
222	  | "dev.inoperative" => some { d with inoperative := none }
223	  | _ =>
224	    -- a kind atom: the source cannot tell this kind, so no device is known to be or not be one
225	    match DeviceKind.ofString ((id.drop 4).toString) with
226	    | some k => some { d with unobservedKinds := k :: d.unobservedKinds }
227	    | none => some d
228	
229	def env (id : String) (e : Env) : Env :=
230	  match id with
231	  | "env.darkness" => { e with darkness := none }
232	  | "env.precipitation" => { e with precipitation := none }
233	  | "env.wet_road" => { e with wetRoad := none }
234	  | "env.ice_or_snow" => { e with iceOrSnow := none }
235	  | "env.visibility" => { e with visibility := none }
236	  | "env.civil_time" => { e with civilTime := none }
237	  | _ => e
238	
239	def relation (id : String) (m : MeasuredRelation) : MeasuredRelation :=
240	  match id with
241	  | "rel.centre_distance" => { m with centreDistance := none }
242	  | "rel.surface_gap" => { m with surfaceGap := none }
243	  | "rel.ahead_behind_in_lane" => { m with aAheadOfB := none }
244	  | "rel.longitudinal_overlap" => { m with longitudinalOverlap := none }
245	  | "rel.oncoming" => { m with oncoming := none }
246	  | "rel.same_direction" => { m with sameDirection := none }
247	  | "rel.bearing" => { m with bearing := none }
248	  | "rel.contact" => { m with contact := none }
249	  | "rel.visible" => { m with visible := none }
250	  | _ => m
251	
252	/-- Blank one atom in a scene. The computed relations are blanked through the kinematics they
253	    would be computed from only when the source lacks those too; a measured value is dropped. -/
254	def scene (id : String) (s : Scene) : Scene :=
255	  match id with
256	  | "ru.subject" => { s with subject := none }
257	  | "rel.occupies" => { s with occupancyObserved := [], occupies := [] }
258	  | "kin.time" => s
259	  | _ =>
260	    { s with users := s.users.map (user id)
261	             structures := s.structures.filterMap (structure' id)
262	             devices := s.devices.filterMap (device id)
263	             env := env id s.env
264	             relations := s.relations.map (relation id) }
265	
266	/-- Blank one atom on every road user but the subject, and in every measured relation not taken
267	    from the subject: what a source that instruments the subject's vehicle alone can say. -/
268	def sceneExceptSubject (id : String) (s : Scene) : Scene :=
269	  { s with users := s.users.map fun u => if s.subject == some u.track then u else user id u
270	           relations := s.relations.map fun m => if s.subject == some m.a then m else relation id m }
271	end Mask
272	
273	/-- The scene as the source would have produced it: every absent atom blanked, every subject-only
274	    atom blanked on everyone but the subject. -/
275	def mask (m : Manifest) (s : Scene) : Scene :=
276	  let s := m.absentIds.foldl (fun acc id => Mask.scene id acc) s
277	  m.subjectIds.foldl (fun acc id => Mask.sceneExceptSubject id acc) s
278	def maskTrace (m : Manifest) (τ : Trace) : Trace := τ.map (mask m)

1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
3	  The temporal operators over a whole trace at once: every operator maps per-instant arrays to a
4	  per-instant array in one pass (or one pass plus O(1) window queries), so a formula costs
5	  O(|φ| · n log n) per grounding. Semantics and Derived both use these; nothing here knows what
6	  a formula or a road user is.
7	
8	  Finite-trace policy: the unobserved past and future are unknown (`windowTruncated`), never a
9	  verdict. A lookback window must be covered and adequately sampled; a lookahead window is true
10	  on a witness, false only when covered.
11	-/
12	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
13	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown
14	
15	namespace TrafficSpec
16	namespace Temporal
17	
18	def const (n : Nat) (r : R) : Array R := Array.replicate n r
19	def truncated (op : String) : R := R.u (.windowTruncated op)
20	
21	-- pointwise connectives
22	def zipAnd (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.and a b
23	def zipOr (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.or a b
24	def zipImplies (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.implies a b
25	def mapNot (a : Array R) : Array R := a.map R.not
26	def allOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipAnd (const n R.t)
27	def anyOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipOr (const n R.f)
28	
29	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
30	-- Unbounded operators: one backward or forward pass with the unobserved tail as unknown.
31	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
32	private def backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
33	  let n := vals.size
34	  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
35	    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
36	    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n tail, tail)).1
37	
38	private def forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
39	  let n := vals.size
40	  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
41	    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
42	    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n head, head)).1
43	
44	/-- `always φ`: φ here and at every later observation, and the unobserved future. -/
45	def alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "always") R.and φ
46	/-- `eventually φ`: φ here or later, or the unobserved future. -/
47	def eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "eventually") R.or φ
48	/-- Strong until: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ until')`, the unobserved future as the tail. -/
49	def untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
50	  let n := ψ.size
51	  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
52	    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
53	    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "until"), truncated "until")).1
54	/-- Since: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ since')`, the unobserved past as the head. -/
55	def sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
56	  let n := ψ.size
57	  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
58	    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
59	    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "since"), truncated "since")).1
60	/-- `once φ`: φ here or at some earlier observation, or the unobserved past. -/
61	def onceAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := forward (truncated "once") (fun v acc => R.or v acc) φ
62	/-- φ at the previous observation (`first` at the trace start). -/
63	def prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
64	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i => if i = 0 then first else φ[i - 1]!
65	
66	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
67	-- Metric windows: positions per instant (time or path), a length d, per-instant values.
68	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
69	/-- φ at every observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant. Unknown where a
70	    position inside the window is missing; where the window is not covered, false on a false
71	    already observed inside it and unknown otherwise; unknown where it is covered but not
72	    adequately sampled. -/
73	def holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
74	  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
75	  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
76	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
77	    match wins[i]! with
78	    | none => R.u missing
79	    | some w =>
80	      if !w.covered then (if (agg.all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
81	      else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
82	      else agg.all w.j0 i
83	
84	/-- The value of φ at the latest observation `j` in `[j0, i]` at which ψ held: unknown where ψ is
85	    unknown at an observation later than any at which it held; none where ψ held nowhere in the range. -/
86	private def atLastAt (ψ φ : Array R) (j0 i : Nat) : Option R :=

90	    | none =>

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
  The temporal operators over a whole trace at once: every operator maps per-instant arrays to a
  per-instant array in one pass (or one pass plus O(1) window queries), so a formula costs
  O(|φ| · n log n) per grounding. Semantics and Derived both use these; nothing here knows what
  a formula or a road user is.

  Finite-trace policy: the unobserved past and future are unknown (`windowTruncated`), never a
  verdict. A lookback window must be covered and adequately sampled; a lookahead window is true
  on a witness, false only when covered.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Temporal

def const (n : Nat) (r : R) : Array R := Array.replicate n r
def truncated (op : String) : R := R.u (.windowTruncated op)

-- pointwise connectives
def zipAnd (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.and a b
def zipOr (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.or a b
def zipImplies (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.implies a b
def mapNot (a : Array R) : Array R := a.map R.not
def allOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipAnd (const n R.t)
def anyOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipOr (const n R.f)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Unbounded operators: one backward or forward pass with the unobserved tail as unknown.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n tail, tail)).1

private def forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n head, head)).1

/-- `always φ`: φ here and at every later observation, and the unobserved future. -/
def alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "always") R.and φ
/-- `eventually φ`: φ here or later, or the unobserved future. -/
def eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "eventually") R.or φ
/-- Strong until: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ until')`, the unobserved future as the tail. -/
def untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "until"), truncated "until")).1
/-- Since: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ since')`, the unobserved past as the head. -/
def sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "since"), truncated "since")).1
/-- `once φ`: φ here or at some earlier observation, or the unobserved past. -/
def onceAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := forward (truncated "once") (fun v acc => R.or v acc) φ
/-- φ at the previous observation (`first` at the trace start). -/
def prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i => if i = 0 then first else φ[i - 1]!

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Metric windows: positions per instant (time or path), a length d, per-instant values.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- φ at every observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant. Unknown where a
    position inside the window is missing; where the window is not covered, false on a false
    already observed inside it and unknown otherwise; unknown where it is covered but not
    adequately sampled. -/
def holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.covered then (if (agg.all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
      else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else agg.all w.j0 i

/-- The value of φ at the latest observation `j` in `[j0, i]` at which ψ held: unknown where ψ is
    unknown at an observation later than any at which it held; none where ψ held nowhere in the range. -/
private def atLastAt (ψ φ : Array R) (j0 i : Nat) : Option R :=
  (List.range (i + 1 - j0)).foldl (fun (acc : Option R) k =>
    match acc with
    | some r => some r
    | none =>
      let j := i - k
      match ψ[j]!.v with
      | .t => some φ[j]!
      | .u => some ⟨.u, ψ[j]!.why⟩
      | .f => none) none

/-- φ at the last observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant at which ψ held.
    Unknown where a position is missing, where ψ is unknown later than any observation at which it
    held, where the window is not adequately sampled (an unobserved later instant could be the last
    one at which ψ held), and where ψ held nowhere in a window that is not covered; false where ψ
    held nowhere in a covered, adequately sampled window. -/
def atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      match atLastAt ψ φ w.j0 i with
      | some r => if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else r
      | none => if !w.covered then truncated op else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else R.f

/-- φ at some observation in the window of length `d` ahead: true on a witness, false only when
    the window is covered, unknown when it runs off the trace. -/
def withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else
        let a := agg.any i w.jl
        if w.covered then a else R.or a (truncated op)

/-- Smallest `k ≥ i` whose value satisfies `p` (size when none), per instant. -/
def nextWhere (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
  let n := vals.size
  (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.set! i (if p vals[i]!.v then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)

/-- Strong until restricted to the window ahead: ∃ j in the window, ψ at j and φ at every
    observation from here to just before j; the unobserved remainder counts as unknown unless φ
    already failed. -/
def untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
  let aggφ := RangeAgg.build φ
  let aggψ := RangeAgg.build ψ
  let firstψ := nextWhere ψ (· = .t)
  let firstφf := nextWhere φ (· = .f)
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else
        let b := firstψ[i]!
        -- φ at every observation from i up to, not including, b (empty when b = i)
        let φBefore (b : Nat) : R := if b ≤ i then R.t else aggφ.all i (b - 1)
        let witnessed : R :=
          if b ≤ w.jl && (φBefore b).v = .t then R.t
          else
            -- false only if every candidate fails: ψ false up to the first φ failure (or the window end)
            let a := firstφf[i]!
            let hi := min a w.jl
            let ψany := aggψ.any i hi
            if ψany.v = .f then R.f
            else
              let why := (if ψany.v = .u then ψany.why else []) ++
                (if b ≤ w.jl then (φBefore b).why else [])
              ⟨.u, if why.isEmpty then [.windowTruncated op] else why⟩
        if w.covered then witnessed
        else R.or witnessed (R.and (truncated op) (aggφ.all i w.jl))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Runs and counts
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The first instant of the latest run of true values ending at the latest true instant ≤ i:
    "since φ became true". `none` before any true; an error where an unknown value hides the
    run's start, and `windowTruncated op` where the run reaches the trace start (it may have
    begun before the recording). -/
def runStartAll (op : String) (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
    let v := vals[i]!
    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
      match v.v with
      | .t =>
        if i = 0 then .error (.windowTruncated op)
        else match vals[i - 1]!.v with
          | .t => acc.2
          | .f => .ok (some i)
          | .u => .error (vals[i - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
      | .f => acc.2
      | .u => .error (v.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1

/-- Path length over which `holds` has held continuously up to each instant: zero where it does
    not hold, unknown where it is unknown, where the path length is missing, or where the run
    reaches the trace start. -/
def distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) : Array QR :=
  let starts := runStartAll "distance_while" holds
  (Array.range holds.size).map fun i =>
    match holds[i]!.v with
    | .f => .ok Q.zero
    | .u => .error (holds[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "distance_while"))
    | .t =>
      match starts[i]! with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "distance_while")

  let starts := runStartAll op sinceφ

  let edgeVal : Array (Except UnknownReason Bool) := (Array.range n).map fun k =>

      | .u, _ => .error (edge[k]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
      | _, .u => .error (edge[k - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))

    index 0 is an upper bound on the true onset, which the caller must treat as such. -/
def firstTrueAll (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
      match acc.2 with
      | .ok (some j) => .ok (some j)
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok none =>
        match vals[i]!.v with
        | .t => .ok (some i)
        | .f => .ok none
        | .u => .error (vals[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "first"))
    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lengths: every operator returns one value per observation of the array it walks.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Lengths

/-- A left fold whose step keeps the length of the array it carries keeps the initial length. -/
theorem size_foldl_carry {α β : Type} (l : List Nat) (f : Array α × β → Nat → Array α × β)
    (hf : ∀ acc i, (f acc i).1.size = acc.1.size) (init : Array α × β) :
    (l.foldl f init).1.size = init.1.size := by
  induction l generalizing init with
  | nil => rfl

1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.TraceLint
3	  The admission check of a trace written by hand (a reviewer's counterexample), before any rule is
4	  run on it. It reads the trace and, for the witness check, a grounding, a case's entities and one
5	  timestamp: no law, rule, formula, contract or reading parameter. Every check is exact, in
6	  rational arithmetic, with no tolerance: a written trace has no measurement noise, and its author
7	  is shown these rules. Traces a source records are never held to it.
8	
9	  `checkTrace` requires:
10	  - identity: track, region and device ids unique within a scene; at most one measured relation
11	    per ordered pair of tracks within a scene; every reference a scene makes (`Scene.references`)
12	    names an entity of that kind present in the same scene, a sight-along-way entry names a
13	    highway, and an `entrance_of` entry names a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or
14	    path, or a kind refining one (`StructureKind.entranceCarriers`); every track a link names
15	    appears in some scene;
16	  - a static map: the same structures in every scene, each identical at every appearance; every
17	    device that does not move (`Device.mobile`) in every scene; a device identical at every
18	    appearance outside its state (`Device.staticPart`);
19	  - one representation of direction and control: a designated direction (`lane.direction`) is
20	    carried only by a structure a vehicle travels in (`directionKinds`: a lane, reserved lane,
21	    turn lane, bicycle lane or path, roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder; a centre turn lane
22	    carries none), and is not the zero vector; each carrier stands on its own, and carriers that
23	    overlap or cross may carry different directions. A device whose control is observed governs
24	    only the travel regions whose traffic it controls, or an intersection, read as control of the
25	    junction itself (`governedKinds`); never a highway, a controlled-access region or a region no
26	    vehicle travels in. Only a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or path, or a kind
27	    refining one, carries the intersection it is an approach to (`lane.enters_intersection`); a
28	    roadway, one-way roadway, shoulder or bicycle lane or path that carries one is a directed
29	    approach segment entering that one intersection, which the check cannot see, and a whole
30	    two-way roadway or bicycle path carries none. Only a stop line or a crosswalk
31	    lists the carriers whose entrance it marks (`entrance_of`). A place no carrier covers has no
32	    designated direction, a device whose `governs` is not written has no observed control, and a
33	    line whose `entrance_of` is not written has no observed entrances; none is filled in;
34	  - valid geometry: a boundary has at least three vertices, all distinct (the first is not
35	    repeated at the end), a non-zero area and no self-intersection; an extent's half-length and
36	    half-width are positive; a path length is not negative; a heading is not the zero vector; a
37	    supplied relation's `surface_gap` has no negative component (each is a distance between the
38	    bodies' nearest points, zero on contact or overlap);
39	  - geometric occupancy: a track whose occupancy is observed has a position, a heading and an
40	    extent, and in a scene with such a track every structure has a valid boundary, because a
41	    pair absent from `occupies` is read as not occupied. The pairs of such a track are not
42	    written by hand: `completeOccupancy` derives them, the pair (track, structure) exactly when
43	    the track's footprint (`footprint`) and the structure's boundary overlap as closed sets
44	    (`Geom.polygonsOverlap`), so touching counts and a body on the line between two lanes
45	    occupies both;
46	  - path length: between consecutive observations of a track's path length it never decreases,
47	    and its increase is at least the straight-line distance between the two positions;
48	  - heading against yaw rate: where a track's heading is the same direction at two consecutive
49	    scenes (parallel and not opposed, whatever the vectors' lengths), the yaw rate integrated
50	    between them, ω (t₁ − t₀) with the later sample's rate held over the interval before it, is a
51	    whole number of turns (a multiple of 360°).
52	  `checkReferences` is the identity part alone. A witness trace is held to the whole check, after
53	  `completeOccupancy`, as a reviewer's trace is.
54	  `checkWitness` requires that `at` is the timestamp of a scene, and that every grounded track and
55	  every entity of the case, with its declared kind, is present in that scene.
56	
57	  Each message names the scene by its timestamp, the entity and the field.
58	-/
59	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
60	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula
61	
62	namespace TrafficSpec
63	namespace TraceLint
64	
65	private def dups {α : Type} [BEq α] (xs : List α) : List α :=
66	  (xs.filter fun x => xs.count x > 1).eraseDups
67	private def at_ (s : Scene) : String := s!"scene t={s.t}"
68	private def qs (q : Q) : String := if q.den == 1 then s!"{q.num}" else s!"{q.num}/{q.den}"
69	private def kindName : EntityKind → String
70	  | .track => "track" | .region => "region" | .device => "device"
71	private def reprStr {α : Type} [Repr α] (x : α) : String := toString (repr x)
72	private def orList (ks : List StructureKind) : String :=
73	  match ks.reverse with
74	  | [] => ""
75	  | [k] => k.toString
76	  | k :: rest => s!"{", ".intercalate (rest.reverse.map (·.toString))} or {k}"
77	
78	/-- Whether an entity of this kind and id is present in the scene. -/
79	def present (s : Scene) (k : EntityKind) (id : Nat) : Bool :=
80	  match k with
81	  | .track => s.tracks.contains id
82	  | .region => (s.structure? id).isSome
83	  | .device => (s.device id).isSome
84	
85	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
86	-- Identity and references
87	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
88	private def identity (s : Scene) : List String :=
89	  (dups s.tracks).map (fun t => s!"{at_ s}: track {t} appears more than once in users")
90	  ++ (dups (s.structures.map (·.id))).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure id {r} appears more than once")

  - heading against yaw rate: where a track's heading is the same direction at two consecutive
    scenes (parallel and not opposed, whatever the vectors' lengths), the yaw rate integrated
    between them, ω (t₁ − t₀) with the later sample's rate held over the interval before it, is a
    whole number of turns (a multiple of 360°).

  `completeOccupancy`, as a reviewer's trace is.
  `checkWitness` requires that `at` is the timestamp of a scene, and that every grounded track and
  every entity of the case, with its declared kind, is present in that scene.

  Each message names the scene by its timestamp, the entity and the field.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace TraceLint

private def dups {α : Type} [BEq α] (xs : List α) : List α :=
  (xs.filter fun x => xs.count x > 1).eraseDups
private def at_ (s : Scene) : String := s!"scene t={s.t}"
private def qs (q : Q) : String := if q.den == 1 then s!"{q.num}" else s!"{q.num}/{q.den}"
private def kindName : EntityKind → String
  | .track => "track" | .region => "region" | .device => "device"
private def reprStr {α : Type} [Repr α] (x : α) : String := toString (repr x)
private def orList (ks : List StructureKind) : String :=
  match ks.reverse with
  | [] => ""
  | [k] => k.toString
  | k :: rest => s!"{", ".intercalate (rest.reverse.map (·.toString))} or {k}"

/-- Whether an entity of this kind and id is present in the scene. -/
def present (s : Scene) (k : EntityKind) (id : Nat) : Bool :=
  match k with
  | .track => s.tracks.contains id
  | .region => (s.structure? id).isSome
  | .device => (s.device id).isSome

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Identity and references
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def identity (s : Scene) : List String :=
  (dups s.tracks).map (fun t => s!"{at_ s}: track {t} appears more than once in users")
  ++ (dups (s.structures.map (·.id))).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure id {r} appears more than once")

def pHaltSpeedTolerance : Term := .param "p.halt_speed_tolerance"
def pLaneOpposedDirectionCos : Term := .param "p.lane_opposed_direction_cos"
def pStopPointTolerance : Term := .param "p.stop_point_tolerance"

def dirY (r : String) : Term := .measure "st_lane_direction" [.var r, .lit "y"]

    ++ arrowsOf "flashing_yellow_arrow"

  .and (shows s "circular_red") (.not (disj (otherThanRed.map (shows s))))

    designated direction, the body-to-region gap within the stop-point tolerance. -/

  , .and (.not (markedBy "stop_line" "sl2" c))

  (.not (.existsRegion (.lit "median_or_divider") "md" (onWay "md" h)))
  (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") "la" (.and (onWay "la" h)

  (.forallRegion (.lit "lane") "ld" (.implies (onWay "ld" h)
    (.cmp (crossOf c "ld") .lt (.neg pCrossDirectionSinMin))))

  (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") "le" (onWay "le" h))
  (.forallRegion (.lit "lane") "lf" (.implies (onWay "lf" h)
    (.cmp (crossOf c "lf") .gt pCrossDirectionSinMin)))

  .forallRegion (.lit "highway") h (.implies (.and (onWay i h) (.not (onWay c h))) φ)

  , .cmp (.measure "st_lane_adjacency_ordinal" [.var c]) .eq (.measure "st_lane_adjacency_count" [.var c])
  , .intent "int.right_turn" (.var subj) (.var i)
  , everyIntersecting i c "hr" (.or (twoDirectional "hr") (oneWayRight c "hr")) ]

def leftTurnCase (i c : String) : Formula := conj
  [ .atom "st_lane" [.var c] []
  , .not (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") "ln" (.atom "st_lane_adjacency" [.var c, .lit "left", .var "ln"] []))
  , .existsRegion (.lit "one_way_roadway") "ow" (occ subj "ow")
  , .intent "int.left_turn" (.var subj) (.var i)
  , everyIntersecting i c "hl" (oneWayLeft c "hl") ]

/-- The entry into i from c under s's steady red alone, after the halt at the place, on one of
    the two permitted turns. -/

  [ entersFrom i c
  , steadyRedAlone s
  , compliedWithStop i c
  , .or (rightTurnCase i c) (leftTurnCase i c) ]

/-- The whole selection of (i, c, s): s governs c, c enters i, and the subject has been in i at
    every observation since such an entry. -/

  [ governs s c
  , entersI c i
  , .since (occ subj i) (entryOnRed i c s) ]

-- s18: pedestrians and other traffic proceeding as directed by the signal at i
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  [ occ p i
  , .existsRegion (.lit "crosswalk") "w" (.and (occ p "w")
      (.existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "ca" (.and (entranceOf "w" "ca") (entersI "ca" i))))
  , .existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "cb" (conj
      [ occ p "cb", entersI "cb" i
      , .existsDevice (.lit "traffic_signal") "sg" (.and (governs "sg" "cb") (greenShown "sg")) ]) ]

def entitled (p i : String) : Formula := conj
  [ .not (.same (.var p) (.var subj))
  , .or (agg p aggPedestrian) (agg p aggTraffic)
  , .cmp (speedOf p) .gt pHaltSpeedTolerance
  , proceedingAsDirected p i ]

/-- s16/s17: the subject yields the right-of-way to p (the node's operationalization). -/
def yieldsTo (p : String) : Formula := .and
  (.not (conj
    [ .cmp (speedOf subj) .gt pHaltSpeedTolerance
    , .derived "prim_closest_approach_within" [.var subj, .var p] [pConflictHorizon]
    , .cmp (.quantity "prim_closest_approach_distance" [.var subj, .var p] [pConflictHorizon]) .lt
        pConflictCentreClearance ]))
  (.not (.atom "rel_contact" [.var subj, .var p] []))

/-- Class of `subject`: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic, ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle -/

/-- Applicability: s1, s7, s9, s10, s11, s13, s14, s15 (with the subject spans s2, s8, s12). -/
def applicability : Formula :=
  .existsRegion (.lit "intersection") "i"
    (.existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "c"
      (.existsDevice (.lit "traffic_signal") "s" (selection "i" "c" "s")))

/-- Obligation: s16 (obligation): but must yield; s17 (standard): the right-of-way; s18. -/
def obligation : Formula :=
  .forallRegion (.lit "intersection") "i"
    (.forallRegion (.lit "travel_region") "c"
      (.forallDevice (.lit "traffic_signal") "s"
        (.implies (selection "i" "c" "s")
          (.forallUser "p" (.implies (entitled "p" "i") (yieldsTo "p"))))))

def rule : Rule :=
  { id := "NRS_484B_307_8a_o3"
    laws := ["NRS-484B-307-8a"]
    binders :=
      [ { name := "subject", cls := clsSubject } ]
    applicability := applicability
    obligation := obligation
    assumptions := []
    intentions := ["int.right_turn", "int.left_turn"]
    operationalizations :=
      [ { standard := "the right-of-way: DEF-NRS-484A-210, 'the right of one vehicle or pedestrian to proceed in a lawful manner in preference to another vehicle or pedestrian approaching under such circumstances of direction, speed and proximity as to give rise to the danger of a crash unless one grants precedence to the other'"
          concepts := ["kin.speed", "prim.closest_approach_distance", "prim.closest_approach_within"]
          params := ["p.conflict_horizon", "p.conflict_centre_clearance", "p.halt_speed_tolerance"]
          convention := "traffic-conflict technique: the danger of a crash is a closest approach of the two centres, under constant velocities, within the time-to-collision horizon (p.conflict_horizon) at a centre distance below the conflict clearance (p.conflict_centre_clearance); the subject grants precedence where, while its speed is above the halt tolerance (p.halt_speed_tolerance), no such approach to the other road user arises. Direction, speed and proximity enter by degree through the constant-velocity extrapolation of both road users."
          surrogate := false } ]
    residues := []  -- the node's, verbatim; not yours to change
    narrowings := []
    surrogate := false }

end TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_307_8a_o3

    ++ arrowsOf "flashing_yellow_arrow"

  , .cmp (.quantity "prim_region_offset_along" [.var subj, .var r, .var c] []) .gt zeroMetres
  , .cmp (.measure "st_region_geometry_distance" [.var subj, .var r]) .le pStopPointTolerance ]

  (.forallRegion (.lit "lane") "ld" (.implies (onWay "ld" h)

  .forallRegion (.lit "highway") h (.implies (.and (onWay i h) (.not (onWay c h))) φ)

  , .cmp (.measure "st_lane_adjacency_ordinal" [.var c]) .eq (.measure "st_lane_adjacency_count" [.var c])
  , .intent "int.right_turn" (.var subj) (.var i)
  , everyIntersecting i c "hr" (.or (twoDirectional "hr") (oneWayRight c "hr")) ]

  , .not (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") "ln" (.atom "st_lane_adjacency" [.var c, .lit "left", .var "ln"] []))
  , .existsRegion (.lit "one_way_roadway") "ow" (occ subj "ow")

  , everyIntersecting i c "hl" (oneWayLeft c "hl") ]

      , .existsDevice (.lit "traffic_signal") "sg" (.and (governs "sg" "cb") (greenShown "sg")) ]) ]

def dirX (r : String) : Term := .measure "st_lane_direction" [.var r, .lit "x"]
def dirY (r : String) : Term := .measure "st_lane_direction" [.var r, .lit "y"]

def disj : List Formula → Formula
  | [] => .ff
  | [φ] => φ
  | φ :: rest => .or φ (disj rest)

def conj : List Formula → Formula
  | [] => .tt
  | [φ] => φ
  | φ :: rest => .and φ (conj rest)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- s1: a steady red signal alone; s18: a green indication
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def arrowDirs : List String := ["left", "right", "straight", "u_turn"]
def arrowsOf (kind : String) : List String := arrowDirs.map fun d => kind ++ "(" ++ d ++ ")"

/-- Every indication of the signal enumeration other than `circular_red`. -/
def otherThanRed : List String :=
  ["circular_green", "circular_yellow", "flashing_red", "flashing_yellow", "dark", "unknown"]
    ++ arrowsOf "green_arrow" ++ arrowsOf "yellow_arrow" ++ arrowsOf "red_arrow"
    ++ arrowsOf "flashing_yellow_arrow"

def steadyRedAlone (s : String) : Formula :=
  .and (shows s "circular_red") (.not (disj (otherThanRed.map (shows s))))

def greenShown (s : String) : Formula :=
  disj ((["circular_green"] ++ arrowsOf "green_arrow").map (shows s))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- s7: after complying with the requirement to stop
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The subject's body is before region r on carrier c: not overlapping it, r ahead along c's
    designated direction, the body-to-region gap within the stop-point tolerance. -/
def haltPlaceAt (r c : String) : Formula := conj
  [ .not (occ subj r)
  , .cmp (.quantity "prim_region_offset_along" [.var subj, .var r, .var c] []) .gt zeroMetres
  , .cmp (.measure "st_region_geometry_distance" [.var subj, .var r]) .le pStopPointTolerance ]

def markedBy (kind v c : String) : Formula := .existsRegion (.lit kind) v (entranceOf v c)

/-- The place of the stop on approach c into i: the stop line marking c's entrance; else the
    crosswalk marking it; else the intersection itself. -/
def stopPlace (i c : String) : Formula := disj
  [ .existsRegion (.lit "stop_line") "sl" (.and (entranceOf "sl" c) (haltPlaceAt "sl" c))
  , .and (.not (markedBy "stop_line" "sl2" c))
      (.existsRegion (.lit "crosswalk") "cw" (.and (entranceOf "cw" c) (haltPlaceAt "cw" c)))
  , conj [ .not (markedBy "stop_line" "sl3" c), .not (markedBy "crosswalk" "cw2" c), haltPlaceAt i c ] ]

def haltedAtPlace (i c : String) : Formula :=
  .and (.derived "drv_motion_complete_halt" [.var subj] [pHaltSpeedTolerance]) (stopPlace i c)

/-- On the approach through c that ends in the entry into i. -/
def onApproach (i c : String) : Formula :=
  .or (.and (occ subj c) (.not (occ subj i))) (.rises (occ subj i))

def compliedWithStop (i c : String) : Formula := .since (onApproach i c) (haltedAtPlace i c)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- s9 / s13: the entry into i from c
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def entersFrom (i c : String) : Formula :=
  .and (.rises (occ subj i)) (.not (.rises (.or (occ subj i) (occ subj c))))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- s11 / s15: the intersecting highway
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- c's designated direction × lane l's (positive where l points to c's left). -/
def crossOf (c l : String) : Term := .sub (.mul (dirX c) (dirY l)) (.mul (dirY c) (dirX l))

def twoDirectional (h : String) : Formula := .and
  (.not (.existsRegion (.lit "median_or_divider") "md" (onWay "md" h)))
  (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") "la" (.and (onWay "la" h)
    (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") "lb" (.and (onWay "lb" h)
      (.cmp (.add (.mul (dirX "la") (dirX "lb")) (.mul (dirY "la") (dirY "lb"))) .lt
        (.neg pLaneOpposedDirectionCos))))))

def oneWayRight (c h : String) : Formula := .and
  (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") "lc" (onWay "lc" h))
  (.forallRegion (.lit "lane") "ld" (.implies (onWay "ld" h)
    (.cmp (crossOf c "ld") .lt (.neg pCrossDirectionSinMin))))

def oneWayLeft (c h : String) : Formula := .and
  (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") "le" (onWay "le" h))
  (.forallRegion (.lit "lane") "lf" (.implies (onWay "lf" h)
    (.cmp (crossOf c "lf") .gt pCrossDirectionSinMin)))

/-- φ of every highway i lies on other than one c lies on. -/
def everyIntersecting (i c h : String) (φ : Formula) : Formula :=
  .forallRegion (.lit "highway") h (.implies (.and (onWay i h) (.not (onWay c h))) φ)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- s8-s11 (right) and s12-s15 (left)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def rightTurnCase (i c : String) : Formula := conj
  [ .atom "st_lane" [.var c] []
  , .cmp (.measure "st_lane_adjacency_ordinal" [.var c]) .eq (.measure "st_lane_adjacency_count" [.var c])
  , .intent "int.right_turn" (.var subj) (.var i)
  , everyIntersecting i c "hr" (.or (twoDirectional "hr") (oneWayRight c "hr")) ]

def leftTurnCase (i c : String) : Formula := conj
  [ .atom "st_lane" [.var c] []
  , .not (.existsRegion (.lit "lane") "ln" (.atom "st_lane_adjacency" [.var c, .lit "left", .var "ln"] []))
  , .existsRegion (.lit "one_way_roadway") "ow" (occ subj "ow")
  , .intent "int.left_turn" (.var subj) (.var i)
  , everyIntersecting i c "hl" (oneWayLeft c "hl") ]

/-- The entry into i from c under s's steady red alone, after the halt at the place, on one of
    the two permitted turns. -/
def entryOnRed (i c s : String) : Formula := conj
  [ entersFrom i c
  , steadyRedAlone s
  , compliedWithStop i c
  , .or (rightTurnCase i c) (leftTurnCase i c) ]

/-- The whole selection of (i, c, s): s governs c, c enters i, and the subject has been in i at
    every observation since such an entry. -/
def selection (i c s : String) : Formula := conj
  [ governs s c
  , entersI c i
  , .since (occ subj i) (entryOnRed i c s) ]

  , .existsRegion (.lit "crosswalk") "w" (.and (occ p "w")

  , .existsRegion (.lit "travel_region") "cb" (conj

      , .existsDevice (.lit "traffic_signal") "sg" (.and (governs "sg" "cb") (greenShown "sg")) ]) ]

  , proceedingAsDirected p i ]
